mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.drive_entry( space_id, parent_id, name, type, size, inherit_parent, trash_state, managed_biz, lock_version, creator, updater ) VALUES ( #{entry.spaceId}, #{entry.parentId}, #{entry.name}, #{entry.type}, #{entry.size}, #{entry.inheritParent}, #{entry.trashState}, #{entry.managedBiz}, #{entry.lockVersion}, CAST(#{actor} AS varchar), CAST(#{actor} AS varchar) ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM public.drive_entry WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND trash_state = 'NORMAL' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN type = 'FOLDER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, name

SELECT e.id, e.space_id, e.parent_id, e.name, e.type, e.file_id, e.size, e.mime_type, e.inherit_parent, e.trash_state, e.trashed_at, e.trashed_by, e.origin_parent_id, e.lock_version, e.creator, e.create_time, e.updater, e.update_time, e.deleted FROM public.drive_entry e WHERE e.space_id = #{spaceId} AND e.trash_state = 'TRASHED' AND e.deleted = 0
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND e.trashed_by = #{trashedBy}
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.drive_entry p WHERE p.id = e.parent_id AND p.trash_state = 'TRASHED' AND p.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY e.trashed_at DESC NULLS LAST, e.id DESC

WITH RECURSIVE chain AS ( SELECT e.id, e.parent_id, e.inherit_parent, 0 AS depth FROM public.drive_entry e WHERE e.id = #{entryId} AND e.space_id = #{spaceId} AND e.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, p.inherit_parent, c.depth + 1 FROM public.drive_entry p JOIN chain c ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE p.space_id = #{spaceId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id <> 0 AND c.depth < 100 ) SELECT id, parent_id, inherit_parent, depth FROM chain ORDER BY depth

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT
, 0 AS depth FROM public.drive_entry WHERE id = #{rootId} AND space_id = #{spaceId} AND deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.space_id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.type, c.file_id, c.size, c.mime_type, c.inherit_parent, c.trash_state, c.trashed_at, c.trashed_by, c.origin_parent_id, c.managed_biz, c.lock_version, c.creator, c.create_time, c.updater, c.update_time, c.deleted, s.depth + 1 FROM public.drive_entry c JOIN sub s ON c.parent_id = s.id WHERE c.space_id = #{spaceId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND s.depth < 100 ) SELECT
FROM sub ORDER BY depth, id

WITH RECURSIVE chain AS ( SELECT e.id, e.parent_id, 0 AS depth FROM public.drive_entry e WHERE e.id = #{entryId} AND e.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT p.id, p.parent_id, c.depth + 1 FROM public.drive_entry p JOIN chain c ON p.id = c.parent_id WHERE p.deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id <> 0 AND c.depth < 100 ) SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM chain WHERE id = #{ancestorId}

SELECT
FROM public.drive_entry WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') AND trash_state = 'NORMAL' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN type = 'FOLDER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, name LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE public.drive_entry SET trash_state = #{trashState}, trashed_at = #{trashedAt}, trashed_by = #{trashedBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE deleted = 0 AND id IN #{id}
UPDATE public.drive_entry SET origin_parent_id = #{originParentId}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM public.drive_entry WHERE space_id = #{spaceId} AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND trash_state = 'NORMAL' AND deleted = 0 AND managed_biz = false ORDER BY CASE WHEN type = 'FOLDER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, name

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT e.id, 0 AS depth FROM public.drive_entry e WHERE e.id = #{rootId} AND e.space_id = #{spaceId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.trash_state = 'NORMAL' UNION ALL SELECT c.id, s.depth + 1 FROM public.drive_entry c JOIN sub s ON c.parent_id = s.id WHERE c.space_id = #{spaceId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.trash_state = 'NORMAL' AND s.depth < 100 ) SELECT e.id, e.space_id, e.parent_id, e.name, e.type, e.file_id, e.size, e.mime_type, e.inherit_parent, e.trash_state, e.trashed_at, e.trashed_by, e.origin_parent_id, e.lock_version, e.creator, e.create_time, e.updater, e.update_time, e.deleted FROM public.drive_entry e JOIN sub s ON s.id = e.id WHERE s.depth > 0 AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN e.type = 'FOLDER' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, e.name LIMIT #{limit}

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT e.id, 0 AS depth FROM public.drive_entry e WHERE e.id = #{rootId} AND e.space_id = #{spaceId} AND e.deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT c.id, s.depth + 1 FROM public.drive_entry c JOIN sub s ON c.parent_id = s.id WHERE c.space_id = #{spaceId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND s.depth < 100 ) SELECT e.id, e.space_id, e.parent_id, e.name, e.type, e.file_id, e.size, e.mime_type, e.inherit_parent, e.trash_state, e.trashed_at, e.trashed_by, e.origin_parent_id, e.lock_version, e.creator, e.create_time, e.updater, e.update_time, e.deleted FROM public.drive_entry e JOIN sub s ON s.id = e.id JOIN public.drive_entry_origin o ON o.entry_id = e.id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE s.depth > 0 AND e.trash_state = 'TRASHED' AND e.trashed_by = #{trashedBy} AND o.origin_key = #{originKey} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.drive_entry p WHERE p.id = e.parent_id AND p.trash_state = 'TRASHED' AND p.deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY e.trashed_at DESC NULLS LAST, e.id DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO public.drive_entry_origin(entry_id, origin_key, creator, updater) VALUES
(#{id}, #{originKey}, CAST(#{actor} AS varchar), CAST(#{actor} AS varchar))
ON CONFLICT (entry_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT o.entry_id, o.origin_key FROM public.drive_entry_origin o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.entry_id IN #{id}

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS ( SELECT e.id, 0 AS depth FROM public.drive_entry e WHERE e.id = #{rootId} AND e.space_id = #{spaceId} AND e.deleted = 0 AND e.trash_state = 'NORMAL' UNION ALL SELECT c.id, s.depth + 1 FROM public.drive_entry c JOIN sub s ON c.parent_id = s.id WHERE c.space_id = #{spaceId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.trash_state = 'NORMAL' AND s.depth < 100 ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sub s LEFT JOIN public.drive_entry_origin o ON o.entry_id = s.id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE o.origin_key IS DISTINCT FROM #{originKey}
